prologue.text: DR. NAZŌ, A MYSTERIOUS MAD SCIENTIST, HAS SENT THE ROGUE PLANET ICARUS ON A CRASH COURSE TOWARD EARTH.

CONTRACTED BY THE PEARL RESEARCH INSTITUTE, PROFESSOR MIRE, A RENOWNED FRENCH ARCHEOLOGIST, JOINED BY MARIE MIRE,
AND CREW ARE SEARCHING THE OCEAN BY SHIP FOR THE WHEREABOUTS OF 'THE LOST CONTINENT.'
THIS CONTINENT IS SAID TO CONTAIN A SPECIAL LENS, NECESSARY FOR THE INSTITUTE'S COMPLETION OF THE SUPER DESTRUCTION BEAM CANNON TO DESTROY ICARUS.
[fast]WHILE ON THEIR EXPEDITION, DR. NAZŌ AND HIS MEN ATTACK THE CREW AND THEIR SHIP WITH THE GIANT MECHANICAL ROBOT, FIVE FINGER.[norm]
SHIPWRECKED ON THE ISLAND RUINS OF ATLANTIS, ONLY MARIE MIRE SURVIVES WITH A BOOK CONTAINING THE RESEARCH MATERIALS FROM HER FATHER.
AS THE RUINS ARE BEING OVERRUN BY THE EVIL SCIENTIST, MARIE FLEES AND DISCOVERS A HIDDEN SECRET TUNNEL LEADING STRAIGHT INTO A DARK, ANCIENT TOMB…
LOCATED WITHIN THE TOMB IS A GOLDEN SARCOPHAGUS INSCRIBED WITH STRANGE HIEROGLYPHS.

SURPRISINGLY, MARIE FINDS TRANSLATIONS FROM THE DEPARTED PROFESSOR’S RESEARCH AND BEGINS TO READ ALOUD:

MARIE: [marie1][slow]'EVERY 10,000 YEARS, WHEN GREAT EVIL RETURNS, POUR A DROP OF WATER ON THE SKELETON AND AWAKEN THE GOD OF JUSTICE, GOLDEN BAT.'[norm]
DISTRAUGHT FOR HER LATE FATHER, MARIE APPROACHES THE SARCOPHAGUS WITHIN THE TOMB AND OPENS IT. INSIDE IS THE CORPSE OF A GOLDEN SKELETON.

USING SOME WATER FROM WHAT LITTLE RESERVES SHE HAS LEFT, SHE POURS A DROP ON THE SKELETON’S CORPSE.

MARIE: [marie2]'PLEASE GOD OF JUSTICE… HELP ME…'
[slow]THE TOMB BEGINS RUMBLING...[wait:1.5] [norm]AND WHAT ECHOES THROUGHOUT IS THE MANIACAL LAUGHTER OF THE ANCIENT FIGURE OF LEGEND AS HE RISES FROM HIS SLUMBER:

game_start: WELCOME TO [gold]GOLDEN BAT[reset]. DRIVE DR. NAZŌ FROM THE RUINS OF ATLANTIS, RECOVER THE LOST RELICS, AND SAVE THE EARTH FROM THE ROGUE PLANET ICARUS...
act1_intro: THE GOLDEN SKELETON RISES FROM THE SARCOPHAGUS. A BLACK CAPE UNFURLS FROM ITS SHOULDERS LIKE THE WINGS OF A GREAT BAT.
[gold]GOLDEN BAT: 'Ten thousand years I have slept. Ten thousand years evil has waited.'

act1_intro.text: MARIE SHRINKS AGAINST THE WALL, TOO FRIGHTENED TO SPEAK.
TIP: TALK TO MARIE IN THE TOMB FOR GUIDANCE, REST, AND SAVING. TYPE 'HELP' FOR COMMANDS.

deck_sighting: THROUGH THE GLASS, THE DEEP SEA DARKENS...
A SHAPE THE SIZE OF A CATHEDRAL RISES FROM THE TRENCH: A GIANT ROBOT, ITS COLOSSAL FIVE-FINGERED HAND SCRAPING THE SEABED.
IT TURNS TOWARD THE ISLAND, AND BEGINS TO CLIMB TOWARD THE SHIPWRECKED BEACH.

deck_sighting.text: [gold]GOLDEN BAT: 'So. Nazō sends his toy. Let it come.'

act1_end: A LOUDSPEAKER CRACKLES ACROSS THE WATER.
DR. NAZŌ: 'Enjoy your little victory, Golden Bat! The lens will be mine, and you will never reach it!'

act1_end.text: THE ISLAND SHUDDERS. FAR BELOW, AT THE OBSERVATION DECK, THE GLASS FLOOR SPLINTERS... AND THROUGH THE CRACKS GLOWS THE LIGHT OF A DROWNED CITY.
[gold]GOLDEN BAT: 'Beneath the ruins... So that is where you hide your secrets, Nazō. [laugh]HA-HA-HA-HA-HAAA...!'

act2_intro: THAT NIGHT, A ROAR SPLITS THE SKY ABOVE THE ISLAND.
THE FLYING SUPER CAR OF THE PEARL RESEARCH INSTITUTE DROPS FROM THE CLOUDS AND SKIDS ACROSS THE SHIPWRECKED BEACH.
PROF. YAMATONE: 'Marie! Thank heavens! And you must be... good grief. You're even more frightening than the legends say.'
PROF. YAMATONE: 'If the lens is somewhere in that drowned city, we're going down after it. All of us. Marie, get in.'
THE SUPER CAR'S WHEELS FOLD INTO FINS. ITS ROOF SEALS SHUT. IT ROLLS INTO THE SURF... AND DIVES.

act2_intro.text: GOLDEN BAT DESCENDS ALONE, DOWN THE CRYSTAL STAIR BENEATH THE SHATTERED OBSERVATION DECK, INTO THE LOST CITY OF ATLANTIS.
TIP: MARIE AND THE PROFESSOR HAVE MADE CAMP AT BELL LANDING. MARIE CAN STILL HELP YOU REST, SAVE, AND REVIVE.

act2_end: GORGO DRAGS HIMSELF ONTO THE DECK OF HIS SUBMARINE, SPITTING SEAWATER.
ADMIRAL GORGO: 'Laugh while you can, Judge! The Eye of Atlantis is already in the Doctor's hands. By tomorrow, Icarus will answer to Nazō alone!'

act2_end.text: THE SUBMARINE CRASH-DIVES AND VANISHES INTO THE BLACK WATER.

act2_end: HIGH ABOVE, IN THE RUINS, THE SPECTRAL WALL GUARDING THE HALL OF ANCIENT TECH BEGINS TO PULSE LIKE A HEARTBEAT.
AND IN THE NIGHT SKY, FOR THE FIRST TIME, THE ROGUE PLANET ICARUS IS VISIBLE TO THE NAKED EYE: A RED STAR, GROWING BRIGHTER.

act2_end.text: [gold]GOLDEN BAT: 'Nazō. I am coming for you. [laugh]HA-HA-HA-HA-HAAA...!'

act3_intro: THE SUPER CAR BURSTS FROM THE SEA AND CLIMBS INTO A SKY STAINED RED.
ICARUS HANGS OVER THE ISLAND LIKE A SECOND MOON, SO CLOSE THAT ITS MOUNTAINS CAN BE SEEN.

act3_intro.text: THE SUPER CAR SETS DOWN AMONG THE CONSOLES OF THE ANCIENT ATLANTEAN LAB. YAMATONE RUNS CABLES FROM ITS ENGINE INTO THE CRYSTAL COMPUTERS.

act3_intro: PROF. YAMATONE: 'If I pour the car's batteries into the old circuits... yes! I can overload Nazō's barrier for a few hours. That's all you'll get, Golden Bat.'
MARIE: 'Golden Bat... come back to us.'
WITH A SOUND LIKE TEARING SILK, THE SPECTRAL WALL COLLAPSES. BEYOND IT, NAZŌ'S FORTRESS AWAITS.

act3_intro.text: [gold]GOLDEN BAT: 'Hold the door, Professor. I will not be long.'
TIP: MARIE AND THE PROFESSOR HAVE MADE CAMP IN THE ANCIENT ATLANTEAN LAB. GATHER ALL SEVEN RELICS BEFORE YOU FACE DR. NAZŌ.

revive: THEN, A SINGLE DROP OF WATER.

revive.text: THE GOLDEN SKELETON RISES ONCE MORE.

game_over: MARIE TIPS THE CANTEEN. NOTHING FALLS. THE WATER IS GONE.

game_over.text: THE GOLDEN SKELETON CRUMBLES TO DUST, AND NAZŌ'S LAUGHTER ECHOES ACROSS THE RUINS...

beats: DR. NAZŌ LIES DEFEATED. BUT ABOVE THE OPEN DOME, ICARUS FILLS THE WHOLE SKY. THE GROUND SHAKES. THE SEA RISES.
MARIE AND PROFESSOR YAMATONE RUN ACROSS THE SPECTRAL BRIDGE INTO THE CHAMBER.

beats.text: PROF. YAMATONE: 'It's too close! Even with the Eye, no cannon on Earth could stop it now!'

beats: MARIE PRESSES HER FATHER'S JOURNAL INTO GOLDEN BAT'S HAND. ON THE LAST PAGE, IN THE PROFESSOR'S HANDWRITING: 'THE JUDGE WAS STRONGEST WHEN THE CHILDREN CHEERED.'

beats.text: GOLDEN BAT UNWRAPS THE BOTAN RICE CANDY AND EATS IT, WRAPPER AND ALL. IT TASTES OF STREET CORNERS, PAPER THEATERS, AND A THOUSAND CHILDREN CHEERING.

beats: FROM THE DROWNED CITY BELOW, THE SPIRITS OF ATLANTIS RISE IN A RIVER OF LIGHT, SINGING, AND POUR THEMSELVES INTO THE SEVEN RELICS.
GOLDEN BAT GROWS. HE RISES THROUGH THE DOME, PAST THE CLOUDS, INTO THE DARK: A GIANT GOLDEN SILHOUETTE STANDING AGAINST THE STARS.

beats.text: WITH A SINGLE STRIKE OF THE SILVER BATON, HE SHATTERS ICARUS INTO A SHOWER OF HARMLESS SHOOTING STARS.

beats: AS DAWN BREAKS, ATLANTIS RISES FROM THE SEA FOR THE FIRST TIME IN TEN THOUSAND YEARS, ITS LANTERNS STILL BURNING.
endings.message: You are a master of Atlantis.

beats: DR. NAZŌ LIES AMONG THE SMOKING CABLES. THE EYE OF ATLANTIS FALLS FREE OF THE CANNON AND ROLLS, GLOWING, TO GOLDEN BAT'S FEET.
DR. NAZŌ: 'Curse you, Golden Bat... I will return!'

beats.text: A HATCH OPENS IN THE FLOOR. NAZŌ DROPS THROUGH IT, AND AN ESCAPE POD SCREAMS AWAY INTO THE NIGHT.

beats: THE FORTRESS SHUDDERS. WITHOUT ITS MASTER, IT BEGINS TO TEAR ITSELF APART, AND THE ISLAND BEGINS TO SINK.

beats.text: GOLDEN BAT CARRIES THE EYE AND THE ICARUS DATA BACK ACROSS THE BRIDGE TO THE LAB, WHERE THE SUPER CAR'S ENGINE IS ALREADY RUNNING.

beats: PROF. YAMATONE: 'The Eye and the data! With these, the Institute's Super Destruction Beam Cannon can stop Icarus! Marie, quickly!'

beats.text: PROF. YAMATONE: 'This is no time for solemn goodbyes!'

beats: THE SUPER CAR ROARS INTO THE SKY, LEAVING GOLDEN BAT ALONE ON THE SINKING ISLAND.

beats.text: THREE NIGHTS LATER, A BEAM OF WHITE LIGHT LANCES UP FROM THE PEARL RESEARCH INSTITUTE, AND THE RED STAR OF ICARUS BURSTS APART.

beats: BENEATH THE WAVES, IN THE TOMB WHERE IT ALL BEGAN, A GOLDEN SKELETON LIES DOWN TO SLEEP AGAIN, LAUGHING...
endings.message: Earth is saved from the rogue planet Icarus.

beats.text: THE CANNON CHAMBER IS DARK. AT ITS CENTER, THE SPECTRAL CANNON POINTS AT THE BLAZING RED STAR OF ICARUS.

beats: DR. NAZŌ: 'Golden Bat! Did you really think you could defeat me without all the relics?'

beats.text: CHAINS OF SPECTRAL LIGHT ERUPT FROM THE FLOOR AND BIND GOLDEN BAT WHERE HE STANDS.
DR. NAZŌ: 'There is nothing you can do to stop me! Watch, Judge, as Icarus answers to ME!'

endings.message: Dr. Nazō has captured Golden Bat and Icarus impacts Earth.

beats: GOLDEN BAT FALLS. HIS BONES SCATTER ACROSS THE CHAMBER FLOOR.

beats.text: DR. NAZŌ: 'The Judge of Atlantis, defeated by a mere mortal! Ha... HA-HA-HA!'

beats: FAR AWAY IN THE LAB, MARIE TIPS HER CANTEEN. BUT THE CHAMBER'S SPECTRAL WARDS SWALLOW EVERY DROP.

beats.text: THE SPECTRAL CANNON FIRES, AND ICARUS TURNS TOWARD THE EARTH.

endings.message: Golden Bat has fallen, and Icarus answers to Dr. Nazō.

thanks: THANK YOU FOR PLAYING [gold]GOLDEN BAT[reset]. (Your last save is still waiting at the title screen.)
